angles.name: The Shrug
angles.hook: Close-up of a departures board flickering to red as a nearby traveler groans, but our traveler just glances up, smiles, and sips her coffee.
angles.concept: While delay chaos is implied off-screen, our calm traveler taps her phone once (no visible UI), then is shown relaxing in a premium lounge chair, unbothered. Edited text: 'Flight cancelled? Covered.'

angles.name: Split-Screen Fate
angles.hook: Split screen of the same traveler at the same gate: on the left he slumps over his suitcase and stares at a receipt, on the right he looks calm.
angles.concept: Left side: stress, crumpled receipts, rubbing his temples on an airport floor. Right side: he checks into a sleek hotel room and drops onto the bed smiling. Text overlays label them 'Without' and 'With NomadGuard'.
angles.cta: Pick your version. Protect your next trip.

angles.name: POV: The 2 A.M. Gate
angles.hook: Handheld POV-style shot of an empty, dimly lit gate at night. Our exhausted traveler lowers her phone and exhales, with a carry-on at her feet.
angles.concept: The relatable worst moment shifts as her expression softens into a relieved smile. Cut to her in a warm hotel robe by a window at sunrise, coffee in hand. Edited text: 'Stranded at 2am → sorted by 2:05.'
angles.cta: Because delays happen. Be covered when they do.

selection.why_selected: It opens on a deeply relatable disruption and pays off with a clear emotional flip. It uses only one traveler, two quiet locations and simple facial beats, so AI video renders it cleanly without crowds, boards or UI.
selection.audience_insight: Frequent travelers aged 25-40 have all lived through the stranded late-night gate. The fear isn't the delay itself but being alone with the cost and the hassle, so showing it solved fast hits the real pain.
selection.why_it_works_on_social: The POV-style, 'that's so me' opening mirrors native TikTok and Reels content, so it stops the scroll without feeling like an ad. Because the story is told through her face and the before/after setting, it reads with the sound off, and the premium sunrise payoff carries the brand feel.
